learning_outcomes.text: Apply theoretical knowledge to design an engineering task from the branch of chemical, food, or process industries.
Design brand new operating sets or processing lines for chemical, food, or process industries.
Design advanced equipment and operating sets for both classical and decentralized energy systems with an emphasis on improving their parameters and using renewable or alternative sources.

Optimize existing systems in terms of intensification of transport phenomena, increase in productivity, heat recovery, reduction in energy demand, minimization of waste generation and ecological impacts.
Design and optimize equipment for new systems with an emphasis on the use of modern R & D trends.

Conduct experimental and CFD analysis of processes in equipment to optimize transport phenomena in terms of energy requirement and processing time, including the definition of suitable scale-up parameters.

degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
